030package dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate;
031
032import dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.DbOps;
033
034/**
035 * An allow* flag changed in DbOps.
036 */
037@SuppressWarnings("serial")
038public class DbOpsChangeEvent extends EventObjectBacktrace {
039  private final DbOps.Allow allow;
040
041  /**
042   * the DbOps that changed
043   * @param source
044   * @param allow
045   */
046  public DbOpsChangeEvent(Object source, DbOps.Allow allow) {
047    super(source);
048    this.allow = allow;
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * @return the DbOops that changed.
053   */
054  public DbOps getDbOps() {
055    return (DbOps) getSource();
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * which permission/allow changed
060   *
061   * @return
062   */
063  public DbOps.Allow getAllow() {
064    return allow;
065  }
066}
